background_story: Cartier was a proud and ambitious thoroughbred with a strong competitive spirit. Born into a lineage of champion racers, he was bred to win. Cartier's owner, a seasoned trainer, recognized his potential and pushed him to excel. As he began to compete, Cartier's emulous nature drove him to outdo his rivals, striving to be the best. He would watch and learn from other horses, studying their techniques and strategies. Cartier's determination paid off as he started to dominate the racing circuit, earning accolades and admiration from fans and competitors alike. His greatest rival, a horse named Apollo, brought out the best in Cartier, fueling his desire to succeed. Their epic battles on the track became the stuff of legend, with Cartier emerging victorious more often than not.
